---
title: "Fig. 2a - Population activity profile, short day"
author: "gavingeddes"
date: "2025-12-18"
output: html_document
---
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Population activity profile: Culex pipiens and
# Culex quinquefasciatus, short-day (SD, 9L:15D) entrainment
# followed by constant darkness (DD)
#
# Overview
#   For each species, this script plots the proportion of
#   individuals that were active in each 30-min bin across the
#   whole recording: ld_days days of light/dark entrainment
#   followed by constant darkness. An individual counts as active
#   in a bin if it recorded at least one beam crossing (activity
#   count > 0). Dark phases during entrainment and the whole DD
#   period are shaded grey.
#
# Input
#   Two TriKinetics monitor files of 30-min binned counts, one row
#   per bin (pip_file, quin_file). Columns 11-42 hold activity
#   channels 1-32 (one individual per channel). Time is counted
#   from the first row of the file, which is assumed to be 00:00
#   clock time, so light_on / light_off give the lights-on and
#   lights-off times within each day.
#
# Output
#   FigA_population_activity_SD_30min_LD3_DD3_propMoving_rawcols11to42_excl.png
#   (two panels, one per species; 7 x 5 in, 600 dpi)
#
# Requirements
#   R with tidyverse.
# =========================================================

library(tidyverse)

# =========================================================
# SETTINGS
# =========================================================
bin_minutes <- 30   # bin length of the input files (min)

# SD entrainment, 9L:15D: lights on 08:00, lights off 17:00
# (decimal hours)
light_on  <- 8.0
light_off <- 17.0

# Number of light/dark days at the start of the recording; all
# later days are constant darkness (DD).
ld_days <- 3

# Input files (30-min bins)
pip_file  <- "pipiens_SD_30min.txt.txt"
quin_file <- "quinque_SD_30min.txt.txt"

# Activity columns in the monitor file: column 11 = channel
# (individual) 1, ..., column 42 = channel 32
raw_act_col_min <- 11
raw_act_col_max <- 42

# Channels (individuals, 1-32) excluded from each species;
# integer(0) means none are excluded.
EXCLUDE_PIP  <- integer(0)
EXCLUDE_QUIN <- c(6, 13)

# Species label (panel strip) font size, in pt. 14.4 pt matches the
# species titles of the average daily activity profiles
# (ggplot2 title size at theme_classic(base_size = 12)).
SPECIES_LABEL_SIZE_PT <- 14.4

# Italic species labels for the panel strips (plotmath italic()).
species_strip_labeller <- as_labeller(
  c("Cx. pipiens"          = "italic('Cx. pipiens')",
    "Cx. quinquefasciatus" = "italic('Cx. quinquefasciatus')"),
  default = label_parsed
)

# =========================================================
# READ A MONITOR FILE AND COMPUTE THE PROPORTION MOVING
# Reads one 30-min binned TriKinetics monitor file, removes
# excluded channels, and returns for each time bin the number of
# active individuals (count > 0), the number scored, and the
# proportion active (prop_moving). time_days is the time since the
# first row, in days.
# =========================================================
read_lam_ct <- function(path, species_label,
                        bin_minutes = 30,
                        raw_act_col_min = 11,
                        raw_act_col_max = 42,
                        exclude_individuals = integer(0)) {

  raw <- readr::read_tsv(
    file = path,
    col_names = FALSE,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  )

  orig_ncol <- ncol(raw)

  if (orig_ncol < raw_act_col_max) {
    stop(
      species_label, ": file has only ", orig_ncol,
      " columns, but raw_act_col_max = ", raw_act_col_max, "."
    )
  }

  # Locate the column containing the "Ct" (counts) data-type code;
  # reported in the console message as a check of the file layout.
  ct_col <- which(purrr::map_lgl(raw, ~ any(.x == "Ct", na.rm = TRUE)))[1]
  if (is.na(ct_col)) stop("Could not find 'Ct' column in: ", path)

  # Activity columns for channels 1-32
  act_cols_idx   <- raw_act_col_min:raw_act_col_max
  act_cols_names <- names(raw)[act_cols_idx]

  raw <- raw %>%
    mutate(
      species   = species_label,
      row_id    = row_number(),
      time_days = (row_id - 1) * (bin_minutes / 60) / 24
    )

  long <- raw %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(act_cols_names),
      names_to = "channel",
      values_to = "activity"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      raw_col    = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(channel, "^X")),
      individual = raw_col - raw_act_col_min + 1,
      activity   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(activity)),
      moving     = if_else(!is.na(activity) & activity > 0, 1L, 0L)
    )

  # Check that columns map to individuals 1-32
  indiv_found <- sort(unique(long$individual))
  if (!identical(indiv_found, 1:32)) {
    warning(
      species_label,
      ": expected mapped individuals 1:32, but found ",
      paste(indiv_found, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Remove excluded individuals
  if (length(exclude_individuals) > 0) {
    long <- long %>%
      filter(!individual %in% exclude_individuals)
  }

  n_individuals_used <- n_distinct(long$individual)

  message(
    species_label,
    " | Ct column detected at raw file column ", ct_col,
    " | raw activity cols used: ", raw_act_col_min, ":", raw_act_col_max,
    " | individuals used: ", n_individuals_used,
    " | excluded individuals: ",
    ifelse(length(exclude_individuals) == 0,
           "none",
           paste(exclude_individuals, collapse = ","))
  )

  if (n_individuals_used == 0) {
    stop("No individuals left after filtering for: ", species_label)
  }

  # Proportion of individuals active in each time bin
  long %>%
    group_by(species, time_days) %>%
    summarise(
      n_moving    = sum(moving, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_scored    = sum(!is.na(moving)),
      prop_moving = n_moving / n_scored,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(species, time_days)
}

# =========================================================
# READ BOTH SPECIES
# =========================================================
pop_avg <- bind_rows(
  read_lam_ct(
    path = pip_file,
    species_label = "Cx. pipiens",
    bin_minutes = bin_minutes,
    raw_act_col_min = raw_act_col_min,
    raw_act_col_max = raw_act_col_max,
    exclude_individuals = EXCLUDE_PIP
  ),
  read_lam_ct(
    path = quin_file,
    species_label = "Cx. quinquefasciatus",
    bin_minutes = bin_minutes,
    raw_act_col_min = raw_act_col_min,
    raw_act_col_max = raw_act_col_max,
    exclude_individuals = EXCLUDE_QUIN
  )
)

# Number of individuals scored per species (denominator of the
# proportion)
pop_avg %>%
  distinct(species, n_scored) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# =========================================================
# DARK-PHASE SHADING
# shade_ld: dark phases of each light/dark day (before lights-on
# and after lights-off); shade_dd: the whole DD period.
# =========================================================
min_day <- floor(min(pop_avg$time_days))
max_day <- ceiling(max(pop_avg$time_days))

shade_ld <- tibble(
  day = seq(min_day, min(ld_days, max_day) - 1, by = 1)
) %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = day,
    xmax = day + 1,
    light_start = day + light_on / 24,
    light_end   = day + light_off / 24
  )

shade_dd <- tibble(
  xmin = ld_days,
  xmax = max_day
) %>%
  filter(xmax > xmin)

# =========================================================
# PLOT
# One panel per species: proportion of population moving over
# time, with dark phases and DD shaded grey.
# =========================================================
p <- ggplot() +

  # DD period
  geom_rect(
    data = shade_dd,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill = "grey85",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # Dark phase before lights-on (LD days)
  geom_rect(
    data = shade_ld,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = light_start, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill = "grey85",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # Dark phase after lights-off (LD days)
  geom_rect(
    data = shade_ld,
    aes(xmin = light_end, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill = "grey85",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data = pop_avg,
    aes(x = time_days, y = prop_moving, color = species),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ species, ncol = 1, labeller = species_strip_labeller) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Cx. pipiens" = "#3B82B8",
    "Cx. quinquefasciatus" = "#C65A1E"
  )) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min_day, max_day, by = 1),
    minor_breaks = NULL,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +

  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Proportion of population moving"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = SPECIES_LABEL_SIZE_PT),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm")
  )

print(p)

# =========================================================
# SAVE
# =========================================================
ggsave(
  "FigA_population_activity_SD_30min_LD3_DD3_propMoving_rawcols11to42_excl.png",
  p,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)
```
